raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Adds a `b200_tp2_kv_offload` tuned preset to `recipes/models/Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B.yaml`: NVIDIA's tuned configuration for serving `nvidia/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4` on two B200s for long-context agentic coding traffic. The baseline command and every other rendering are unchanged; the preset appears in the command builder's Preset row for B200 with the `nvfp4` variant.

## Claims

- TP2 with expert parallelism on two B200s, MTP with three draft tokens (the recipe's existing `spec_decoding: mtp` mode), FP8 KV cache, `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float16`, `--async-scheduling`, `--block-size 64`, `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`, `--max-num-seqs 48`, `--no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager`, and vLLM native CPU KV offload with `--kv-offloading-size 160` GiB summed over the two ranks.
- Turns the default-on `encoder_parallel` feature off and selects the Python frontend, matching the measured configuration.
- Measured on `vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0`, two B200 SXM 180 GB, a 942-request multi-turn agentic coding trace (about 64k mean input tokens, outputs capped at 12k) at concurrency 16 with real MTP acceptance: 936 output tok/s/GPU, 8.7 ms mean ITL, 0.70 s mean TTFT, all requests completed. The table is in the preset's runbook.
- Bumps `meta.date_updated`.

## Validation

- The exact rendered flag set was served on the pinned image on two B200s on an NVIDIA cluster against the trace above; the startup log shows every flag taken as given (MTP, native offload connector, FlashInfer TRT-LLM MoE backend, 37 GiB of GPU KV per rank). No public run link yet; an InferenceX AgentX lane with the same settings is being prepared, and this preset's `source` will be repointed to it when it lands.
- The `Recipes / Validate` check passes and the preview deployment renders the preset: the B200 NVFP4 Preset row composes `vllm serve nvidia/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-NVFP4 --trust-remote-code --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --tensor-parallel-size 2 --moe-backend flashinfer_trtllm` plus the preset's flags, the parsers and the MTP speculative config, with `--mm-encoder-tp-mode data` dropped; the baseline B200 command and every other rendering are unchanged. The vLLM `/pr-checklist` skill was not run.

## Details

- A preset rather than a change to `hardware_overrides.blackwell`: these settings are workload-specific (admission cap, offload tier), so they should not alter the baseline B200 command.
- The runbook states that further concurrencies and the same-image comparison against the recipe's baseline command are being collected; they will follow in a separate PR.
- `source` points at this PR.

---

- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

files.patch:
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@ meta:
   provider: "Qwen"
   description: "Multimodal MoE model with gated delta networks architecture, 397B total / 17B active parameters, up to 262K context"
   date_added: 2026-02-16
-  date_updated: 2026-10-07
+  date_updated: 2026-10-29
   tasks:
     - multimodal
     - text
@@ -265,6 +265,57 @@ strategy_overrides:
       env:
         VLLM_SSM_CONV_STATE_LAYOUT: "DS"
 
+presets:
+  b200_tp2_kv_offload:
+    label: "TP2 + KV offload (multi-turn agentic)"
+    hardware: b200
+    strategy: single_node_tp
+    variants: [nvfp4]
+    workload: "Multi-turn agentic coding, ~64k input, KV-reuse-bound (mean ITL under 20 ms)"
+    description: "One TP2 engine with expert parallelism on two of the node's eight B200 GPUs: MTP with three draft tokens, FP8 KV cache, float16 Mamba SSM cache, async scheduling, and a 160 GiB host KV tier so prefixes survive across turns; admission is capped at 48 sequences to hold mean ITL under 20 ms."
+    source: { label: "vLLM #64607", href: "https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64607" }
+    image: "vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0"
+    tp: 2
+    select:
+      frontend: python
+      features: { spec_decoding: mtp, encoder_parallel: false }
+    args:
+      - "--enable-expert-parallel"
+      - "--async-scheduling"
+      - "--block-size"
+      - "64"
+      - "--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype"
+      - "float16"
+      - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+      - "16384"
+      # Admission stays at 48 sequences so mean ITL holds under 20 ms up to 64 clients; the rest queue.
+      - "--max-num-seqs"
+      - "48"
+      # Qwen3.5 mixes Gated DeltaNet and attention layers; the hybrid manager keeps prefix caching across both.
+      - "--no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager"
+      # vLLM sums --kv-offloading-size over the TP ranks: 80 GiB of host KV per rank.
+      - "--kv-offloading-backend"
+      - "native"
+      - "--kv-offloading-size"
+      - "160"
+    runbook: |
+      Measured by NVIDIA on vLLM v0.32.0 (`vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0`) on two B200 SXM 180 GB with a
+      942-request multi-turn agentic coding trace (about 64k mean input tokens, most prefix tokens
+      reused across turns, outputs capped at 12k tokens), replayed at fixed concurrency with real
+      MTP acceptance (mean acceptance length 3.2 to 3.3). Host: 512 GiB RAM and 200 GiB /dev/shm per
+      server for the 160 GiB offload tier.
+
+      | Concurrency | Output tok/s/GPU | Mean ITL | Mean TTFT |
+      |---|---:|---:|---:|
+      | 16 | 936 | 8.7 ms | 0.70 s |
+
+      Further concurrencies and the comparison against this recipe's baseline command on the same
+      image and trace are being collected and will follow in a separate update.
+
+      The 48-sequence cap trades time to first token for inter-token latency at 64 clients; raise
+      `--max-num-seqs` if TTFT matters more than ITL for your traffic. The offload tier only helps
+      workloads that revisit long prefixes; drop the `--kv-offloading-*` flags for single-turn traffic.
+
 guide: |
